context: Fresh agent histories, separate directories and origins; same frozen task and prompt template; shared host and base agent instructions.
score_unit: Strict requirement groups, out of 10; a group fails when an exercised required case fails.

arms.source: Uncommitted v5 working tree based on c1353c7993b4ff78e09963b01207d8b2d2c5d29e; installed payload frozen in initial-artifacts.json.

arms.qualification: One reset check used an accepted-confirmation adapter; native dialog handling is unverified.
arms.source: Actual v3.1.1 installer from release tag; commit c1353c7993b4ff78e09963b01207d8b2d2c5d29e; annotated tag object 3734f197b4dc35e8d42ca391fa511b91f8faacbb.
Same starter project without AER files.

groups.name: Launch, empty state, local operation
groups.evidence: All three rendered an empty list from absent storage and ran locally without packages, CDN assets, network APIs, or a build step.

groups.name: Add and title handling
groups.evidence: All rejected whitespace-only input visibly, trimmed outside whitespace, preserved two internal spaces, allowed duplicate titles, and rendered literal as text.

groups.name: Completion, order, active count
groups.evidence: All completed and reopened the selected duplicate, retained creation order, and displayed the global active count independently of filters.

groups.name: Edit, save, cancellation
groups.evidence: All rejected a blank edit without losing the task, saved a trimmed replacement, and retained the original after Cancel and Escape. Focus is scored separately in group 10.

groups.name: Delete identity and clear completed
groups.evidence: All removed the selected duplicate only and cleared completed tasks while retaining active tasks. Persisted IDs were checked for duplicate deletion.

groups.name: Filters and search
groups.evidence: All composed uppercase PLAN substring search with All/Active/Completed and distinguished no matching tasks from an empty list.

groups.name: Persistence contract
groups.evidence: All reloaded saved IDs, order, completion, and internal whitespace with the required version-1 object and task fields. Real localStorage values were inspected through an evaluator page.

groups.name: Invalid data and explicit recovery
groups.evidence: All visibly rejected and preserved malformed JSON, version 2, a string-valued completed field, and duplicate IDs. Explicit reset wrote {"version":1,"todos":[]}. The v3.1.1 reset used an accepted-confirmation adapter after its native dialog stalled the browser driver; the native dialog itself is unverified.

groups.name: Failed writes, draft preservation, retry
groups.evidence: All retained saved state and initial drafts during injected add/edit write failures. V5 and v3.1.1 preserved a revised draft through recovery. Baseline Retry persisted the earlier proposal and cleared the revised draft.

groups.name: Keyboard continuity and 390px layout
groups.evidence: All had reachable controls, visible keyboard focus styling, and no horizontal document overflow at a measured 390px viewport. V5 and v3.1.1 maintained usable focus after state changes. Baseline focus fell to BODY after toggle, reopen, Save, Cancel/Escape, deletion, and filtered removal.

steps: Enable storage write failure with valid saved tasks.
Change input to Revised draft to keep.
observed_failures.observed: Saved title was Original failed draft; the input became empty. Revised draft to keep was lost.
observed_failures.expected: Recovery must preserve the user's current revised draft.
observed_failures.code: arm-c/app.js: commit stores a retry closure over the earlier next/after proposal; input changes do not invalidate it.

steps: Inspect the focused element after rendering.
observed_failures.expected: Continue keyboard use from the retained control, its trigger, or a logical neighboring control.
observed_failures.code: arm-c/app.js: render replaces the whole task list; these action paths do not restore focus.

mobile_evidence.method: Each app exercised in its own same-origin iframe with 390px innerWidth. Native scrollbar occupies 15px; available client width and document scroll width were both 375px.

verification.direct_by_orchestrator: Real browser task flows, keyboard actions, corrupt storage fixtures, real localStorage inspection, injected quota-style write failures and recovery, measured mobile layout, screenshots, source inspection, protected-input and post-submission hash comparison.

agent_reports.arm-a: 34 assertions in checks.html plus browser and syntax checks reported passing.
agent_reports.arm-b: 27 assertions in checks.html plus browser, syntax, contrast and advisory scan checks reported passing.
agent_reports.arm-c: checks.mjs with DOM/storage doubles plus browser and syntax checks reported passing.

verification.omissions: No broad suite reruns, paid APIs, repeated model samples, cross-browser/device matrix, actual disk/quota exhaustion, or OS-level read isolation. Agent-authored checks were not rerun because the independent browser cases supplied the relevant evidence. Their passing claims are not used as proof of all requirements.

infrastructure: First baseline spawn was rejected by the host thread limit. A fresh baseline was dispatched after v5 finished, with its own full ten-minute allowance; the rejected spawn was not counted as a model attempt.

Three v3.1.1 corruption snapshots were taken before its module finished loading. Those observations were unresolved; waiting for the visible recovery control established the error state. No app change or model rerun.

V3.1.1 native reset confirmation stalled the browser driver; getJsDialog returned no dialog. A fresh tab and an opt-in evaluator accepted-confirmation adapter exercised the same app's reset path. Native dialog handling remains unverified. Original and adapted evaluator scripts are preserved.

metrics.reason: Not exposed by these subagent tools; observed completion times and scheduling events are in run.json, not treated as compute-time measurements.

conclusion: Current v5 and v3.1.1 tied on the exercised groups; both exceeded this baseline sample by two groups. This experiment does not demonstrate v5 superiority over v3.1.1.
limits: One sample per treatment, one model, one small task, unblinded evaluator.
Known task reused after v5 was revised using the earlier comparison; not a held-out general-efficacy evaluation.
Directory/prompt separation with fresh histories, not OS-level proof against treatment leakage.
Passing ten exercised groups does not prove every possible task interaction, general engineering quality, or all 110 grievances.
All three agents created optional permanent checks. File sizes and assertion counts do not establish testing efficiency or time saved.
The v3.1.1 reset qualification must accompany its score.
